title: Simplifying Certified Payroll & Compliance Payments for Construction Projects with Truss
summary: Certified payroll compliance isn’t just a reporting task — it’s a critical safeguard for construction firms managing prevailing-wage and public works projects. With government audits and payment delays on the rise, even small reporting errors can jeopardize timelines and profitability. Truss Payments simplifies certified payroll management with auditable payment trails, digital disbursements, and accounting integrations that keep payroll accurate and defensible. From field time capture to fringe tracking and final reporting, Truss delivers the transparency contractors need to maintain compliance and cashflow confidence.
